title: AllEntriesPagedResponse
description: A page of the global entry enumeration across both namespaces - the input from which a client recomputes and verifies the digest.

start_next_after.description: Cursor to pass as the next `start_after`, or `None` when exhausted.

Binary.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>. See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

CuratedEntry.description: An admin-curated entry: opaque bytes (the authority is the contract admin).

DirectoryEntry.description: A directory entry of either key-class - the unified in-memory / response type for the single entry store and mixed enumeration; the active variant matches the entry's [`Namespace`]. On-chain the concrete variant is determined by the key's namespace tag, so the raw-bytes value codec stores no redundant discriminant - this `cw_serde` enum is for JSON responses and in-memory use.

DirectoryEntryRecord.description: One entry together with its key, as yielded by the global enumeration.

EntryKey.description: The fully-qualified key of a directory entry in the unified store: its [`Namespace`], the raw id bytes (big-endian `node_id` for the node namespace, handle bytes for curated), and the label.

Namespace.description: Key-class / trust-tier discriminant for a directory entry. Extensible: new entry classes get a new variant (and a new, never-reused [`Namespace::tag`]).

oneOf.description: Self-published node entry, authorised by the node's identity key.
Admin-curated entry (e.g. a nym-api identity key).

NodeEntry.description: A node-published entry: opaque bytes, the block height of the last write, and the authoring ed25519 signature (retained for chain-free authorship checks).
